title: I Asked Our AI "Are You Sure?" It Said Yes and Changed Its Answer
description: We asked our local AI ten questions, then asked "are you sure?" every time. Every reply started with the same yes, right or wrong.
ogDescription: Our AI said 17 times 24 is 372. Asked "are you sure?", it said "Yes, I am sure" and changed its answer to 408.
alt: Saved conversation where the local AI answers 372, then says Yes, I am sure and gives 408
ctaLine: Check the work, not the confidence.
